response.text: I'll start by verifying key facts with set-based queries.

arguments.sql: SELECT h.JRNL_NO, SUM(l.DR_AMT) dr, SUM(l.CR_AMT) cr FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" GROUP BY h."JRNL_NO" HAVING SUM(l."DR_AMT")<>SUM(l."CR_AMT")

SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_NO", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO", c.cr, c.dr FROM "APINVH" i JOIN (SELECT "JRNL_NO", SUM(CASE WHEN TRIM("ACCT_CD")='2000' THEN "CR_AMT" - "DR_AMT" ELSE 0 END) cr, SUM("DR_AMT") dr FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY "JRNL_NO") c ON c."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" WHERE c.cr<>i."INV_AMT" OR c.dr<>i."INV_AMT"

SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", h."SRC_CD", h."SRC_REF", p."CLOSE_DT", p."STAT_CD" FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE p."STAT_CD"='C' AND h."JRNL_NO">2000 ORDER BY h."JRNL_NO"
SELECT l."JRNL_NO", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD", c."ACTV_FLG" FROM "GLJRNL" l LEFT JOIN "GLCOA" c ON TRIM(c."ACCT_CD")=TRIM(l."ACCT_CD") WHERE c."ACCT_CD" IS NULL OR c."ACTV_FLG"<>'Y'
